_why: The floor for the optional-dependency CLOSURE, read by BOTH
scripts/check-optional-closure.mjs (pre-install, zero-dependency) and
tests/guards/image-build-install-resilience.test.ts (post-install). One
file because two copies of a ratchet drift.
optionalEntries: `optional: true` package entries in package-lock.json.
npm reads that flag on the ENTRY, not package.json's
optionalDependencies, so a regeneration that drops it makes
onnxruntime-node's network postinstall fatal again (#1231).
Dependabot's grouped dev-dependency update dropped exactly 8 --
A FLOOR rather than an exact set: the closure is npm's to compute and a
legitimate dependency change moves it. Raising it is a visible line in a
diff; lowering it should be too.
`libc` entries are deliberately NOT here. They have their own guard
(tests/guards/lockfile-libc-preserved.test.ts, floor 22 over a partial
record) and they do not need a PRE-install check: a libc-stripped
lockfile still installs, it just ships wrong-platform binaries, so that
guard runs normally. Only the optional flags kill `npm ci` before any
test can fire, which is the whole reason this file is shared with a
script that runs first.
